help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the accuracy of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Accuracy.Scale}%, reduces the endurance cost of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Endurance.Scale}%, and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.
power_short_helps: Enhances Accuracy, Reduces Endurance Cost, and Increases Attack Rate
